title: GLOSAR dictionary entry (one entry = one file in data/dictionaries/, file name <lang>-<headword>.json)

lang.description: ISO 639-3 code; must be listed in data/languages.json

variants.description: Other spellings of the same word (another orthography or dialect form)

concept.description: Id from data/concepts.json (the basic word list)

dialect.description: Dialect id listed for the language in data/languages.json

orthography.description: Orthography id listed for the language in data/languages.json

status.description: draft: entered, not checked; sourced: copied from the published source named in `source`; reviewed: confirmed by a speaker (name in `reviewed_by`)

audio.description: File in audio/, Opus, at most 50 KB

license.description: Only when the data is not under the repository licence (for example CC BY-SA 4.0 for words taken from Wikipedia or Wiktionary)
